decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program offers little differentiation and is largely subsumed by the broader express line D, so its option value is low and it is dropped to free resources.
The 72-hour express option still offers a distinct fast-response promise and is relatively cheap to keep while demand uncertainty remains, so it is kept as an option.
This product line has its own page and several models, indicating a stronger commitment and enough realized value to keep open.
The digital platform is a strategic option with high future uncertainty and potential value, so it is kept despite moderate running costs.
The fire and smoke protection door has gained prominence and addresses a clear safety need, so its value is likely realized and it is very likely kept.
